visual_en: A small 2-head tall character facing right. Dark navy wet short hair decorated with a glowing white pearl hairpin. Deep bronze skin with intense emerald eyes. Wearing a dark teal traditional Korean top. Small, luminous cyan magical water droplets float around the body. Holding a long, bright silver spear tipped with a brilliant cyan gemstone. A small mesh bag with a single harpoon attached hangs at the waist. The overall silhouette is sharp and brightly accented with cyan and gold to stand out against dark backgrounds.
pose_en: Standing in a firm, ready-to-strike stance, eyes focused forward.
vfx_en: A few bold teal water streaks shooting forward and small droplets
lore: 해녀 작살꾼 — 멀리 꿰뚫는다. 무기 작살.
concept: 이 게임 세계(요괴 · 이면 — 한국 설화) 영웅. 2~3등신 치비 도트, 어두운 돌바닥과 밝은 회색 바닥 둘 다에서 보이는 몸 색.
